title: clematis alpina subsp. ochotensis
intro: Clematis alpina subsp. ochotensis, commonly known as the Siberian clematis or alpine clematis, is a flowering plant species that belongs to the buttercup family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of Clematis alpina subsp. ochotensis are attributed to its sedative and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate anxiety and stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
